description: Versioned, backend-independent sensor input capabilities. These string IDs and result semantics are SDK data, not native Host enums. A new capability requires a reviewed catalog definition plus a backend implementation; declaring a name alone does not produce data. Used definitions participate in schema-3 contract fingerprints.

surface.description: One logical sensing surface. A backend model binding may realize it as one or more collision shapes belonging to a rigid body. The contract does not name backend body/geom APIs.

frame.description: One named coordinate frame in the sensor model; its realization belongs to the model/backend binding.

range.description: One scalar range channel. A nonnegative evaluated value is an SI distance; a negative value is an opaque no-hit marker, not a distance. The backend preserves its evaluated marker without normalization.

orca.contact.v1.description: One aligned record per contact touching exactly one selected surface, or both recipients when internal contacts are explicitly included. Forces act ON the recipient bound surface. Surface index is zero-based in the input's ordered objects list. Each instance receives its own force sign; opposing identity is rigid-body identity, not shape identity.
orca.contact.v1.no_hit: Zero records. Capacity overflow is an error, never silent truncation.

results.name: surface_index
results.description: Zero-based index of the receiving surface in the ordered objects list.

results.name: counterpart_rigid_body_id
results.description: Opaque opposing rigid-body ID, stable for the loaded model; never a geometry ID.

results.name: position
results.description: Contact position relative to the requested frame origin.

results.name: normal_force
results.description: Normal force vector acting on the receiving surface, not its norm.

results.name: tangential_force
results.description: Tangential force vector acting on the receiving surface, not its norm.

orca.contact.v1.layout_order: Projected result fields follow this results-list order; vendor aliases of the same result are sorted by name. JSON mapping key order does not affect memory layout.

direction.description: Required finite nonzero 3-vector in the declared frame; the backend normalizes it.

max_distance.description: Required finite positive maximum distance in metres.

exclude_self.description: Exclude all geoms belonging to this sensor model instance, including unqueried housing and sibling bodies; not a single body or welded group.

orca.raycast.v1.description: Orca-computed ray from the named frame origin along its local direction. Returns distance to the nearest eligible collision-geometry surface, including static geometry, in [0, max_distance]. Visual-only geometry is not a target. No native sensor definition or sensor data slot is required.
orca.raycast.v1.no_hit: Exactly -1 when no eligible surface is hit within max_distance. Nonfinite input or backend results are errors.

orca.range.v1.description: Evaluated ray distance along the bound range channel. No backend-native sensor struct crosses the provider ABI.
orca.range.v1.no_hit: Any finite negative value denotes no hit and is not interpreted as a distance. Its exact numeric value is unspecified and preserved from the backend; no normalization is performed. Nonfinite values are invalid.

orca.frame.parent_rotation.v1.description: Immutable rest/model-local rotation of the bound object relative to its immediate parent frame. Row-major 3x3 matrix maps local vectors to parent coordinates. It is not the current world orientation or a dynamically evaluated joint rotation; a backend without this model attribute rejects the capability.
orca.frame.parent_rotation.v1.no_hit: Not applicable. Missing object or unavailable rest orientation fails preparation.

orca.sample.time.v1.description: Time of the physics source state represented by this input, not an already integrated simulator time.
orca.sample.time.v1.no_hit: Not applicable; no dynamic sample is available before the first physics substep after prepare/reset.

orca.sample.dt.v1.description: Positive duration of one physics substep, not the logical environment step duration.
orca.sample.dt.v1.no_hit: Not applicable; no dynamic sample is available before the first physics substep after prepare/reset.

orca.sample.index.v1.description: Zero-based physics substep number since reset; one input sample per physics substep.
orca.sample.index.v1.no_hit: Not applicable; no dynamic sample is available before the first physics substep after prepare/reset.

resolution.description: Required [rows, cols], each an integer in 1..256. Result shape is [rows, cols, 3]; ordinary total input ABI byte limits also apply.

fov_degrees.description: Required [horizontal, vertical] full angular fields of view in degrees, each finite and in (0, 180].

orca.contact_grid.v1.description: Orca-computed ideal force grid at the scene-bound site, not a calibrated sensor reading. Eligible contacts touch exactly one side of the site's rigid weld group; contacts internal to that entire group are excluded. The group is a contact candidate set, not a sensor asset boundary. Transform contact positions and total forces acting ON that group (normal plus tangential) into site coordinates. Accept only positions with z > 0 within the angular field of view. Sum the signed Fx, Fy, Fz components in each angular cell without normalization, pressure conversion, response, calibration or filtering.
orca.contact_grid.v1.projection: For site-local contact position (x,y,z), horizontal angle = atan2(x,z); vertical angle = atan2(y,hypot(x,z)). Uniform angular bins span [-horizontal_fov/2,+horizontal_fov/2] and [-vertical_fov/2,+vertical_fov/2]. Both bounds are inclusive; exact boundary hits clamp to the first or last cell. Rows increase with vertical angle (+Y), columns increase with horizontal angle (+X); +Z is forward. Row-major value[rows][cols][3] stores Fx,Fy,Fz.
orca.contact_grid.v1.no_hit: A fixed all-zero grid when there are no eligible contacts. Nonfinite input or backend results are errors.

results.name: value
results.description: Fixed shape derived from resolution. Three signed total-force components per cell, before vendor sensor response.

direction.description: Required finite nonzero 3-vector in the scene-bound site's local frame; the backend normalizes it. [0,0,1] is the site's +Z direction.

max_distance.description: Required finite positive maximum distance in metres.

orca.site_raycast.v1.description: Orca-computed ray from the scene-bound site origin along its normalized local direction. Returns the nearest eligible collision-geometry surface distance in [0,max_distance], including static geometry. Visual-only geometry is not a target. All geoms of the site's rigid weld group are always excluded. This fixed exclusion is not the model-instance exclude_self policy of orca.raycast.v1; no exclusion option or model-local frame reference is accepted.
orca.site_raycast.v1.no_hit: Exactly -1 when no eligible surface is hit within max_distance. Nonfinite input or backend results are errors.
